# Render's Web Service build command is `pip install -r requirements.txt`, so
# this file exists to satisfy that path.
#
# GENERATED FROM pyproject.toml — do not edit by hand.
#
# pyproject.toml is the source of truth. This file mirrors
# [project].dependencies and nothing else: no dev extras, no jarvis extras.
# The JARVIS voice stack in particular is deliberately absent, because it pulls
# an audio stack the API server does not need.
#
# `pip install -e .` is the better command and is what render.yaml uses. It
# reads pyproject directly and cannot drift. Use this file only when the build
# command is fixed to a requirements file.
#
# tests/test_packaging.py asserts the two stay in sync, so a dependency added
# to pyproject without mirroring it here fails the suite.
